entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Cathedral of the Dormition of the Theotokos, also known as the Belgrade Cathedral, is an Eastern Orthodox church located in Szentendre, Hungary. It is under jurisdiction of the Eparchy of Buda of the Serbian Orthodox Church and serves as its cathedral church.
